useGraphEngineering (the real hook, including its single-flight, retained-submission and admission guards)

run records: the UI tests' summaryRun() (unit-only captured records), not native runs
file search, platform.selectFile/saveFile and fileService.stat/readFileRange (real temp files; no OS dialogs), transport (Playwright bridge instead of RPC)

results.name: the library is one dialog with Workflow, Versions, Use, Share and Advanced; there is no second modal
workflows say Built-in or Yours, before and after selection, in English and Chinese
version rows: Version N, Latest only when several are offered, dates only for user versions, built-ins list what the Host offers
digest and library revision live under Advanced and match the Host; nothing else shows them
a chosen user version is exactly what New run shows and what the Host instantiates; the design's origin and Used-by follow from that fact
New run names the built-in workflow and the version the Host offers, without a version picker for a single version
while a run owns the workspace the library can be browsed and previewed, every mutation is refused with a reason, and export to disk is blocked
a library revision conflict shows its error with Refresh right beside it; Refresh clears it and shows the other window's change
saving the design defaults to the workflow it came from, not to the Workflow dropdown, and the new version is selected from the returned list
unsaved design edits are disclosed before saving, for a version and for a new workflow, and the preview is built from that design
a version whose name differs from the workflow's says so before confirming; the service's derived name is unchanged
a design that came from a built-in explains that built-ins take no versions and defaults to a new workflow; Duplicate to edit selects the copy
export names the exact workflow and version, ignores the unsaved canvas, saves exactly the reviewed JSON, and treats a cancelled dialog as neither success nor failure
import is three steps: choosing and previewing mutate nothing, saving is an explicit choice of target with the reviewed gate
manual JSON lives under Advanced; editing it drops the preview and the review, so only a reviewed preview can be saved
after a library revision conflict the reviewed preview survives Refresh and the explicit retry succeeds
the Share tasks, disclosures and results read in Simplified Chinese
Open in Runs opens New run with the selected workflow and version and does nothing else, also while a run owns the workspace
Run again on a run pinned to a built-in version that is no longer offered says so, changes nothing on its own, and Continue carries the request to the offered version
the same version number with a different definition is not the version the run used
a run whose workflow is no longer in the library says so and offers no version to continue with
a pin that is exactly offered (built-in current version, or a user version) seeds the form at once, as before
Continue carries only structurally compatible values by stable identity, lists the rest with reasons, and leaves missing required values blocking Review
a required value the historical form never had stays missing after Continue and Review stays blocked
the historical-pin notice and the carry report read in Simplified Chinese
